fields.label: Delivery Note Field Mapping
fields.description: Map the Delivery Note custom fields used when matching carrier invoice lines. Field names differ between systems, so they are configurable here.

fields.label: Match by Delivery Note Tracking Field
Tracking Number Field(s)
fields.description: Delivery Note fieldname(s) that hold the tracking number (e.g. custom_tracking_number). Comma-separate to try several. Used to match an invoice line to a Delivery Note by tracking number.

fields.label: Carrier Field
fields.description: Optional: Delivery Note fieldname holding the carrier name.

fields.label: Tracking Link Field
fields.description: Optional: Delivery Note fieldname holding the tracking URL.

fields.label: Return Field Mapping
fields.description: Return shipments (e.g. the return label / vacuum bag send-out) use separate Delivery Note fields. Their tracking number is matched too, so return-label invoices attach to the outbound return delivery.

fields.label: Return Tracking Number Field(s)
fields.description: Delivery Note fieldname(s) holding the return tracking number (e.g. custom_return_tracking_number). Comma-separate to try several. Matched like the normal tracking field.

fields.label: Return Carrier Field
fields.description: Optional: Delivery Note fieldname holding the return carrier.

fields.label: Return Tracking Link Field
fields.description: Optional: Delivery Note fieldname holding the return tracking URL.

fields.label: Carrier Invoice Accounting
fields.description: Turn imported carrier invoices into Purchase Invoices, so freight reaches the ledger and the supplier balance can be reconciled against the bank.
Off by default: creating accounting documents is the site owner's decision.
fields.label: Create Purchase Invoices from Carrier Invoices

fields.description: Carrier invoices dated before this are left alone. Older freight predates the accounting go-live and belongs to a one-off adjustment, not here. Leave empty to invoice everything.
fields.label: Accounting Cutover Date

fields.description: Used for parcels that could not be matched to a delivery. Matched parcels follow the cost centre of the delivery they belong to, so freight lands wherever the sale did.
fields.label: Fallback Cost Center

fields.description: Submit automatically. Leave OFF to review drafts first (recommended).
fields.label: Auto Submit Purchase Invoices

fields.options:
One row per party that invoices you. Matched against Billed Via first and then Carrier: a DPD parcel booked through SendCloud is billed by SendCloud, so the debt is SendCloud's.
A carrier established abroad invoices at 0% with the VAT reverse charged and needs a reverse-charge tax template, not the domestic one.

fields.description: What to do when an invoice names a carrier that is not in the table. Stopping is the safe default: guessing the supplier books the freight against the wrong party and reports no error.
fields.label: Unmapped Carrier
